POLYCHORDS

A polychord is a combination of two chords (usually triads) that, when played together, create a more complex sound. Palychords are notated with a horizontal line, as opposed to the diagonal line used in slash chords. Polychords are popular among keyboard players, but they don’t transfer easily to guitar. Fig. 21 offers a few “finger friendly” polychords to give you an idea of their intriguing sonic possibilities.
